# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Morning edition for Tuesday, 17 November 2026 (IST). Covers Monday 16 Nov to early Tuesday. Stock and index figures are Monday 16 Nov NSE closes; IBJA's latest rates are Monday 16 Nov (PM), and AGLOC has posted a new period for 17 Nov.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Bajaj Finance closes its QIP at ₹1,025 a share, above the floor
Bajaj Finance's QIP committee closed the issue late on Monday 16 Nov and allocated 114,146,341 equity shares to qualified institutional buyers at ₹1,025 each, above the ₹992.25 floor price set when the issue opened on 11 Nov. At that price the allocation works out to about ₹11,700 crore, the amount the board had approved for the QIP.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the largest NBFC has just priced fresh equity above its floor in a week when foreign investors were net buyers, which is the reference point institutions will carry into other NBFC equity offers, including Muthoot Fincorp's planned ₹3,000 crore IPO.
Sources: [NSE: Bajaj Finance QIP closing and pricing, 16 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/BAJFINANCE_16112026234915_BSENSE_Intimation_Issue_closing_pricing.pdf) · [BSE: same filing](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/95153dec-f5c7-4013-90b5-92e3c1d7c92a.pdf) · [BusinessLine (Reuters): QIP launch, 11 Nov](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/bajaj-finance-launches-11700-crore-share-sale-sets-floor-price-at-99225/article71690436.ece)

### SEBI sets up a group to rewrite the IPO, QIP and preferential-issue rules
SEBI said on 16 Nov it has formed a sub-group of its Primary Market Advisory Committee, chaired by NSE MD and CEO Ashish Chauhan, to review Chapters II, IIA, IV, V and VI of the ICDR Regulations covering IPOs, FPOs, preferential issues and QIPs. Its terms of reference include eligibility conditions, promoter and pre-issue lock-in, allocation and allotment, offer-document disclosures, pricing and price discovery, and lead managers' due-diligence certificates.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Muthoot Fincorp's IPO is at the draft red herring prospectus stage, so changes to disclosure, lock-in or price-band rules could apply to its offer documents if they take effect before the issue. SEBI has given no timeline, and any change would first come as a consultation paper.
Sources: [SEBI PR No. 73/2026](https://www.sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/nov-2026/sebi-constitutes-a-sub-group-of-pmac-to-review-specified-provisions-of-the-sebi-icdr-regulations-2018_105790.html)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

PTI's write-up of Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 filing, carried by BusinessLine and Business Standard on 16 Nov, adds the half-year totals: profit of ₹1,485 crore for April–September against ₹568 crore a year earlier, on total income of ₹6,567 crore, and Stage III down to 1.07% from 1.41% a year earlier ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/ipo-bound-muthoot-fincorp-q2-profit-doubles-to-779-cr-asset-quality-improves/article71707222.ece) · [BSE filing](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/1b013a70-8ca6-4aff-ae25-9ef12e008024.pdf)). Muthoot Fincorp's investor page showed no new filing since the 14 Nov board-meeting intimation. Muthoot Microfin's board meets on Thursday 19 Nov on audited half-year accounts for Muthoot Fincorp's restated consolidated statements ([NSE](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_13112026182612_PriorintimationBoardMeeting19112026SD.pdf)).

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

Indian shares rose on Monday: the Nifty 50 closed at 25,291.10 (+0.58%) and Nifty Financial Services at 28,015.40 (+0.57%), with foreign investors net buyers of ₹4,864.7 crore (provisional). Gold lenders lagged: Muthoot Finance fell 2.2% to ₹2,777.00 and Manappuram 1.4% to ₹303.80, while IIFL Finance rose 1.8% to ₹652.35 ([NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_16112026.csv) · [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_16112026.csv) · [ET FII/DII](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/fii-dii-activity/cash-provisional)).

### Update: Gold hits a one-year low; AGLOC's 85% ceiling falls to ₹10,508 a gram
Spot gold touched $3,830 an ounce on Monday, its lowest since October 2025, and was at $3,852.95 at 3:38 p.m. New York time, as markets priced a December Fed hike and the dollar held near a 19-month high; gold is down 31.5% from January's record. AGLOC's new period for 17 Nov sets the 85% ceiling at ₹10,508 a gram on a jewellery reference of ₹12,363, down from ₹10,574 and ₹12,440 for 14–16 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the per-gram ceiling for fresh loans is ₹66 lower from today, and a falling price thins the collateral cushion on loans written near the cap.
Sources: [AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/) · [IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/) · [CNBC (Reuters)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/gold-holds-steady-as-investors-await-warsh-remarks-for-rate-signals.html) · [Economic Times (Reuters)](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/us-stocks/wall-street-guide/gold-price-slides-to-one-year-low-heads-for-worst-year-since-2015/articleshow/135902147.cms)

### October wholesale inflation rises to 12.29% on fuel and power
Provisional WPI inflation rose to 12.29% in October from 11.39% in September, the commerce ministry said on 16 Nov, with fuel and power inflation at 32.84%. Primary articles rose to 9.24%, while manufactured products eased to 9.54%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: high wholesale inflation keeps pressure on RBI ahead of its 2–4 Dec policy meeting, after October's repo hike, which bears on the cost of Muthoot Fincorp's bank lines and new NCDs.
Sources: [PIB: WPI October 2026](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2336762&lang=1&reg=1) · [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/economy/news/wpi-inflation-rises-to-12-29-in-october-as-fuel-power-prices-surge-126111600916_1.html)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

RBI cancelled the registrations of 49 NBFCs (43 in West Bengal) and accepted the surrender of 13 NBFC and one HFC registrations, five of them under the new Type I exemption ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63979) · [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63978)). It also announced a ₹50,000 crore two-day VRRR auction for today to absorb surplus liquidity ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63984)). No new RBI notification since 11 Nov. Details in the rules report.

### RBI tells Tata Sons again that Upper Layer rules, including listing, apply
CNBC-TV18 reported on 16 Nov that RBI, in a letter dated 16 Nov, told Tata Sons to comply with all regulations for Upper Layer NBFCs, including the requirement to list. The letter answers Tata Sons' 6 October request for guidance and comes ten days before its 26 Nov board meeting.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none directly, as Muthoot Fincorp is in the Middle Layer. It shows RBI holding the scale-based listing rule for Upper Layer NBFCs even against the largest group holding company, a rule that would apply to Muthoot Fincorp if it were ever moved up a layer.
Sources: [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/exclusive-rbi-tells-tata-sons-to-comply-with-listing-norms-20035318.htm)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No gold-loan peer filed results on Monday. Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 coverage is in the market section above.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

Bajaj Finance's QIP close is the lead story. No other deals today.

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

### Update: CRIF High Mark sees a small rise in gold-loan overdues since March, but no stress
CRIF High Mark's South Asia MD Sachin Seth told the Economic Times that gold-loan repayment is slightly better than a year ago, with "a small uptick in overdues since March among some lenders and in larger loans". He put industry gold-loan growth at about 60% and said the bureau sees no systemic issue.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: this matches the March-to-August rise in delinquencies that TransUnion CIBIL reported (covered 15 Nov). Bureaus say the stress is concentrated in larger tickets, which is where Muthoot Fincorp's mix will get compared with its peers'.
Sources: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/lenders-strike-gold-amid-a-broader-shift-to-secured-credit/articleshow/135869576.cms)

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Tuesday: Gold loan sector

**Price.** Gold has fallen hard: spot touched $3,830 an ounce on Monday, down 31.5% from January's record of $5,594.82 ([Economic Times (Reuters)](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/us-stocks/wall-street-guide/gold-price-slides-to-one-year-low-heads-for-worst-year-since-2015/articleshow/135902147.cms)). In India, IBJA's 999 rate was ₹1,34,971 per 10 g on Monday afternoon, against ₹1,37,692 on 12 Nov ([IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/)). AGLOC's per-gram ceilings have come down in step: the 85% figure was ₹10,720 for 13 Nov, ₹10,574 for 14–16 Nov and is ₹10,508 today ([AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/)).

**Credit.** Bureaus see the book still growing fast, about 60% across the industry by CRIF High Mark's estimate, with overdues edging up since March, mostly among some lenders and in larger loans ([Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/lenders-strike-gold-amid-a-broader-shift-to-secured-credit/articleshow/135869576.cms)). Muthoot Fincorp's own Stage III fell to 1.07% on 30 September from 1.41% a year earlier ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/ipo-bound-muthoot-fincorp-q2-profit-doubles-to-779-cr-asset-quality-improves/article71707222.ece)).

**Capital and funding.** Large lenders are raising equity as gold prices fall: Bajaj Finance closed its QIP at ₹1,025 a share on Monday ([NSE](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/BAJFINANCE_16112026234915_BSENSE_Intimation_Issue_closing_pricing.pdf)), and IIFL Finance's preferential-issue EGM is on 4 Dec. A falling collateral price combined with fresh competitor capital is the setting for Muthoot Fincorp's H2 growth plan and its IPO.

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Tuesday, 17 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

Two RBI registration actions and one SEBI press release came out on Monday 16 Nov. None changes a rule that applies to Muthoot Fincorp. RBI's notifications feed still ends at the 11 Nov Domestic Money Transfer Directions, and nothing addressed to banks changes NBFC funding, risk weights, co-lending or gold loans. IBBI's what's-new list for 16 Nov carries only resolution-plan approvals; no new NHB or FIU-IND notice turned up for NBFCs.

### [NEW] RBI cancels the registrations of 49 NBFCs
RBI cancelled the certificates of registration of 49 NBFCs under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act, through orders dated 1 to 29 October 2026; 43 of them have registered offices in West Bengal, 41 in Kolkata. RBI did not give the grounds for each cancellation, and the companies can no longer carry on non-banking financial business.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none directly. Any business partner, co-lending counterparty or loan-sourcing entity that relies on an NBFC registration should be checked against RBI's list.
Reference: Press Release 2026-2027/1501 · Addressed to: public (NBFCs named) · Issued: 16 Nov 2026
Sources: [RBI press release](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63979) · [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/rbi-cancels-registrations-of-43-west-bengal-nbfcs-41-in-kolkata-nine-share-one-address/135900686) · [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/rbi-cancels-registrations-of-49-nbfcs-13-nbfcs-one-hfc-surrender-licences-20035213.htm)

### [NEW] 13 NBFCs and one HFC surrender their registrations, five under the Type I exemption
RBI cancelled the registrations of 13 NBFCs and one housing finance company that surrendered them: six left the business, five qualified as unregistered Type I NBFCs, and three ceased to exist after a merger, dissolution or strike-off. The Type I route is open to NBFCs with assets under ₹1,000 crore that take no public funds and have no customer interface.

cards.title: Bajaj Finance closes its QIP at ₹1,025 a share, above the floor
cards.summary: Bajaj Finance's QIP committee closed the issue late on Monday 16 Nov and allocated 114,146,341 equity shares to qualified institutional buyers at ₹1,025 each, above the ₹992.25 floor price set when the issue opened on 11 Nov. At that price the allocation works out to about ₹11,700 crore, the amount the board had approved for the QIP. Sources: NSE: Bajaj Finance QIP closing and pricing, 16 Nov · BSE: same filing · BusinessLine (Reuters): QIP launch, 11 Nov
cards.impact: the largest NBFC has just priced fresh equity above its floor in a week when foreign investors were net buyers, which is the reference point institutions will carry into other NBFC equity offers, including Muthoot Fincorp's planned ₹3,000 crore IPO.

cards.title: SEBI sets up a group to rewrite the IPO, QIP and preferential-issue rules
cards.summary: SEBI said on 16 Nov it has formed a sub-group of its Primary Market Advisory Committee, chaired by NSE MD and CEO Ashish Chauhan, to review Chapters II, IIA, IV, V and VI of the ICDR Regulations covering IPOs, FPOs, preferential issues and QIPs. Its terms of reference include eligibility conditions, promoter and pre-issue lock-in, allocation and allotment, offer-document disclosures, pricing and price discovery, and lead managers' due-diligence certificates.
cards.impact: Muthoot Fincorp's IPO is at the draft red herring prospectus stage, so changes to disclosure, lock-in or price-band rules could apply to its offer documents if they take effect before the issue. SEBI has given no timeline, and any change would first come as a consultation paper.

latest_circulars.title: SEBI sub-group of PMAC to review ICDR Regulations
latest_circulars.summary: This is a review, not a rule change. SEBI's Primary Market Advisory Committee sub-group, chaired by Ashish Chauhan of NSE, will review Chapters II, IIA, IV, V and VI of the ICDR Regulations (IPOs, FPOs, preferential issues, QIPs), covering eligibility, lock-in, allotment, disclosures, pricing and due-diligence certificates.
latest_circulars.impact: Muthoot Fincorp's IPO offer documents are governed by Chapter II; any change would come first as a SEBI consultation paper, with no date given.

latest_circulars.title: 13 NBFCs and 1 HFC surrender Certificates of Registration
latest_circulars.summary: RBI cancelled the registrations of 13 NBFCs and one housing finance company that surrendered them: six left the business, five qualified as unregistered Type I NBFCs, and three ceased to exist after a merger, dissolution or strike-off. The Type I route is open to NBFCs with assets under ₹1,000 crore that take no public funds and have no customer interface.
latest_circulars.impact: none. Muthoot Fincorp takes public funds and deals with customers, so it stays a registered NBFC; the exemption is relevant only to small group investment companies.

latest_circulars.title: RBI cancels Certificate of Registration of 49 NBFCs
latest_circulars.summary: RBI cancelled the certificates of registration of 49 NBFCs under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act, through orders dated 1 to 29 October 2026; 43 of them have registered offices in West Bengal, 41 in Kolkata. RBI did not give the grounds for each cancellation, and the companies can no longer carry on non-banking financial business.
latest_circulars.impact: none directly. Any business partner, co-lending counterparty or loan-sourcing entity that relies on an NBFC registration should be checked against RBI's list.

latest_circulars.title: RBI deputy governor: microfinance FOIR cap stays at 50%, income limit under review
latest_circulars.summary: This is a speech, not a circular, so no rule changes. Deputy Governor Murmu said on 13 Nov that excluding the principal of some loans from the 50% FOIR calculation "would defeat this purpose", that the ₹3 lakh household-income ceiling will be reviewed, and that credit bureaus have been told to move microfinance records out of the consumer segment.
latest_circulars.impact: the FOIR rule and the ₹3 lakh ceiling are unchanged for Muthoot Microfin and any group microfinance lending; a revised income threshold would come only through an amendment to the microfinance Directions.

latest_circulars.title: Watch item: RBI drafting curbs on private equity control of more than one NBFC (Reuters)
latest_circulars.summary: Two people told Reuters that RBI is working on proposals to stop a private equity firm holding a controlling stake in more than one NBFC, with holdings of 15% or less treated as financial investments. A draft would go to public consultation first.
latest_circulars.impact: nothing changes until RBI publishes a draft. Under the existing Acquisition of Shareholding or Control Directions, 2025, any acquisition of control of an NBFC, or of 26% or more of its equity, already needs RBI's prior approval (RBI Directions).

latest_circulars.title: RBI refreshes its "All you wanted to know about NBFCs" FAQs
latest_circulars.summary: RBI's NBFC FAQ page now carries the line "Updated as on November 11, 2026". It covers registration under Section 45-IA, the ₹10 crore net owned fund floor (existing NBFCs have until 31 March 2027), scale-based layers, lending against shares at a 50% LTV, and the April 2026 Type I / Unregistered Type I NBFC framework.
latest_circulars.impact: no new obligation for NBFCs. The FAQ restates existing rules; this edition did not compare it line by line with the previous version, so it reads as a refresh unless RBI flags a change.

latest_circulars.title: SEBI aligns FATCA/CRS reporting with the Income-Tax Rules, 2026
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI told registered intermediaries that qualify as Reporting Financial Institutions to follow Rules 238 to 240 and Form 166 of the Income-Tax Rules, 2026, which replaced the 1962 Rules from 1 April 2026. They must update self-certification capture, controlling-person roles, account classification and Form 166 XML generation, and upload FATCA/CRS certifications to the KRAs.
latest_circulars.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is not a SEBI intermediary. Reporting financial institutions outside SEBI's remit report under the same Income-Tax rules and Form 166, so the field changes SEBI lists apply to them as well.

latest_circulars.title: RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions
latest_circulars.summary: RBI issued the Reserve Bank of India (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026, which consolidate the existing DMT instructions for banks and authorised payment system operators and take effect immediately. Cash pay-outs stay capped at ₹10,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month per beneficiary, and walk-in remitters can send up to ₹5,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month through BCs, with registration on a verified mobile number and a self-certified OVD.
latest_circulars.impact: not addressed to NBFCs; it applies to an NBFC only where it acts for a bank or payment operator. The velocity checks and alerts on unusual credit spurts in paras 15–17 describe controls also relevant to cash-heavy lending.
